findings.title: nvv4l2h264enc0 takes 33% of per-element processing time
findings.why: This element spends the most time producing each buffer.
findings.fix_text: Start optimisation here; the rows below rank the rest.

findings.title: Zero-copy broken between capsfilter1 and capsfilter4: buffers leave GPU memory and return
findings.why: A CPU<->GPU copy on every frame costs bandwidth and latency; NVMM/dmabuf should stay on the GPU end to end.
findings.fix_text: Keep the path in device memory across capsfilter3->nvvconv2 (use nvvidconv, or negotiate NVMM caps so no element copies to system memory).

findings.title: videoconvert0 (videoconvert) runs in software; nvvidconv is available on this platform
findings.why: A software element burns CPU and adds latency where the SoC has a dedicated block.

findings.title: No queue before the encoder/sink: the whole pipeline runs on one thread
findings.why: Without a queue the source, conversion and encode share a single streaming thread, so any stall in one stalls all.
findings.fix_text: Insert a queue upstream of nvv4l2h264enc0 to give it its own thread.
